description: SOWEKI provides 11 reservoir-outflow demand series from three German water utilities. The CSV observations use 15-minute intervals and cover different parts of 1 January 2024 to 28 January 2026, for small rural supply areas without major industrial consumers. This resource is provided by Sehmer, Felix; Hoffmann, Maximilian; Kloos, Norberth and coauthors. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists CSV formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The provider documents resampling, timezone conversion, rounding and removal of missing observations. These processing choices affect time-series reuse. The page does not establish reuse or maintenance beyond the originating study or small project. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
